channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ricky Rubio | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ricky Rubio from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Trey Murphy on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
After their coach confirmed that Rubio, who was then with the Utah Jazz, was suiting up, Murphy admitted that he had a reality check.

“I haven't played one college game yet. I'm about to play against Ricky Rubio. He hit seven threes. The thing was, he wasn't that great of a shooter in the league,”

Trey Murphy on Ricky Rubio, May 26, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Trey Murphy on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
story about playing against Ricky Rubio in a tiny gym in Spain during his freshman year in college in 2018.

“We're warming up, layup lines, and I shoot my layup and go back to the other line where you're about to rebound. I look on the other end, and I see this dude in a full-arm (tattoo) sleeve. I'm like, ‘He kind of looks like Ricky Rubio. But why would Ricky Rubio be playing against Rice University right now?'”

Trey Murphy on Ricky Rubio, May 26, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Ricky Rubio, Joe Ingles
item.description:
Mitchell told The Athletic over the weekend.

“When Mike was saying that, it wasn’t that I didn’t appreciate it then, but when you’re as young as I was then, you don’t know what you don’t know. “I find myself telling the guys in this locker room the same stuff that Mike and Joe (Ingles) and Ricky (Rubio) used to tell me. What we have this season? This isn’t always the NBA. Not every locker room is like this.”

Donovan Mitchell on Ricky Rubio, Joe Ingles, Dec 24, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Mitchell was more than excited to play with Rubio again and said that he learned a lot from the Spanish player.

“He [Rubio] really helped me lock in on the little details as far as my work, as far as my craft, as far as the possession game,”

Donovan Mitchell on Ricky Rubio, Sep 16, 2022. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Koby Altman on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
With limited depth on the wing, Bickerstaff made the decision to put Markkanen in the starting lineup at small forward so Love would have more room to play.

“I thought we had a tremendous offseason by getting Evan, Lauri and Rubio,”

Koby Altman on Ricky Rubio, Dec 28, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Love on Ricky Rubio, Facundo Campazzo
item.description:
#CavsKevin Love on the Ricky Rubio-Facundo Campazzo dustup:

“That was funny, that would’ve been one of the worst fights I’ve ever seen in my life”

Kevin Love on Ricky Rubio, Facundo Campazzo, Oct 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Joe Mande on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
But Rubio has always shared a special bond with Timberwolves fans, the imperfect fan base and the imperfect player linked arm-in-arm ever since he arrived from Spain in 2011, and even after he left in a trade in 2017.

“I think for three years straight at ‘Parks and Rec’ my Secret Santa gift was a Ricky Rubio jersey,”

Joe Mande on Ricky Rubio, Dec 21, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
D'Angelo Russell on playing with Ricky Rubio:

“It’s an easy dynamic to play with a guy like him who is just a heady basketball player. We complement each other well. I like it.”

D'Angelo Russell on Ricky Rubio, Dec 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Dane Moore:Karl-Anthony Towns on his old and new teammate Ricky Rubio:

“I've been through this with him and his mom. And now we're going through this with mine.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Ricky Rubio, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
“He's young so maybe like bones or whatever are going to heal quicker than maybe someone who was older. If Ricky (Rubio) got hurt, I don't think Ricky would come back.”

Mikal Bridges on Ricky Rubio, Mar 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Ricky Rubio, Devin Booker
item.description:
Carlisle said:

“They’ve got a great perimeter core, really for top to bottom. Booker’s one of the best scorers in the game. Rubio’s one of the best game managers in the game and he’s had huge games against us.”

Rick Carlisle on Ricky Rubio, Devin Booker, Nov 29, 2019. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: James Jones on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
James Jones on Ricky Rubio's success at the FIBA World Cup:

“I was geeked, he made me look good. But that's what Ricky does, he makes people look good.”

James Jones on Ricky Rubio, Sep 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Steve Blake on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Steve Blake:

“Management made some great changes for our roster this year. Ricky Rubio is an ultimate point guard pass first guy that;'s gonna create and make guys have fun when they're on the court. And we have a couple guys who are going to demand a double-team, so I think we're surrounding those players with guys that can help us win.”

Steve Blake on Ricky Rubio, Aug 25, 2019. Source: 247Sports.

item.title: Kelly Oubre on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Oubre on Ricky Rubio:

“I’ve always respected his game and now we’re on the same side together.”

Kelly Oubre on Ricky Rubio, Jul 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: James Jones on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
#SunsGM James Jones on new PG Ricky Rubio:

“His ability to control a team, to run a team, to lead a team, is something that we missed, something that we haven’t had recently in Phoenix. With his addition, I expect our young guys to be able to take a huge leap forward this year.”

James Jones on Ricky Rubio, Jul 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Raul Neto on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
“I wouldn't say (my body) failed me but of course it wasn't able to handle all of the ups and downs of the season because I came from not playing at all, to playing like 20-30 minutes when Ricky (Rubio) got hurt and that's when I had one injury,”

Raul Neto on Ricky Rubio, Jun 22, 2019. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Dennis Lindsey on Rubio at the trade deadline:

“Unfortunately a team leaked something, and it was unethical. ... There are a lot of scenarios where we think Ricky could be back.”

Dennis Lindsey on Ricky Rubio, Apr 25, 2019. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Igor Kokoskov on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Igor Kokoskov on Ricky Rubio:

“I have an internal joke with Ricky. It’s that he’s a better person and a worse player than I thought.”

Igor Kokoskov on Ricky Rubio, Apr 3, 2019. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Jason Kidd, Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Dennis Lindsey on Ricky Rubio:

“One of the best players in my 22 years of playing all the way through a defensive possession... It's weird how inordinately good he is on a post switch... Catching rebounds on the move like Jason Kidd.”

Dennis Lindsey on Jason Kidd, Ricky Rubio, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Fred Katz:Westbrook on guarding Rubio:

“It was not about me or him. Let's get past that. We're done with that.”

Russell Westbrook on Ricky Rubio, Apr 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Jonas Jerebko on Ricky Rubio, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Jonas Jerebko on Russell Westbrook's comments on Ricky Rubio:

“We’ve got other guys to step up andRicky’s great at moving the ball. He’s gonna find the open man. We’re not really worried. We’re just gonna play together, next man up, and Ricky’s going to keep playing well.”

Jonas Jerebko on Ricky Rubio, Russell Westbrook, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Jonas Jerebko on Ricky Rubio, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Jerebko on if Westbrook keys in on stopping Rubio, how that affects the Jazz:

“Yeah, it doesn’t work like that with our team. We’ve got a lot of guys that can step up, so let’s see what they take away.”

Jonas Jerebko on Ricky Rubio, Russell Westbrook, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Snyder on Rubio:

“He had a heck of a game. It’s one of the big reasons we were able to win the game. Right now, Ricky would agree, this isn’t time to celebrate an individual game.... He’s just gotta keep being solid.”

Quin Snyder on Ricky Rubio, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Ricky Rubio, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Quin Snyder on Russell Westbrook’s guarantee to shut Rubio off:

“He’s capable of doing that. I think that’s something they’re capable of, affecting the game that way. But people forget that Ricky’s played in a lot of big games. ... I don’t think you overreact to that stuff.”

Quin Snyder on Ricky Rubio, Russell Westbrook, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: LeBron James on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
LeBron James said of Calderon.

“I think he's just a smart, smart basketball player. I mean, I've played against the Spain National Team for a long time and there's not one player on that team that's not, pretty much, smart and knows how to play. You look at the Gasol twins. You look at Ricky Rubio. And Rodriguez and Jose and all those guys, they were just really smart and they were never going to beat themselves. So for us to have him has just been an extra security blanket for us.”

LeBron James on Ricky Rubio, Apr 4, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Utah coachQuin Snyder on Ricky Rubio:

“He has become acclimated to me, to system & to his teammates. He has gradually come to where he’s not having to think about so many things & he’s just playing. His decisions are good. He’s playing with confidence. That’s who we think he is”

Quin Snyder on Ricky Rubio, Feb 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Justin Bieber on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
“All I heard was all Ricky Rubio all the time. There was just this fascination with him.... Everywhere we went, there would be hundreds of people at a hotel waiting and welcoming us. If it was a big city or a small city or in another country—it didn’t matter. People were always screaming for Ricky. It was like everyone just needed to see him or wanted to touch him or say hello to him. It was like he was bigger than the world at that time.”

Justin Bieber on Ricky Rubio, Nov 22, 2017. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Teague on replacing Rubio:

“He was a fan favorite. I hear it every day. No, seriously. I really do.”

Jeff Teague on Ricky Rubio, Sep 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @APkrawczynski.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Jason Kidd, Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Dennis Lindsey:

“We believe Ricky Rubio will be a 2017 facsimile of Jason Kidd.”

Dennis Lindsey on Jason Kidd, Ricky Rubio, Jul 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Dante Exum on Ricky Rubio
item.description:
Exum said the combination of Rubio’s ability to defend and find players on offense stood out when he played against the Spaniard.

“He drags the big very well, that’s one of the things when I’m working on stuff, ‘Do it like Rubio,’so hopefully I can get to see what he does during practice and incorporate that into my game,”

Dante Exum on Ricky Rubio, Jul 1, 2017. Source: Deseret News.
